prompt: In the TidyVault app, users can permanently delete a saved backup archive from the storage list. I need the label for the delete button on the archive row, and the single line of confirmation dialog text shown before the deletion happens, warning that the archive and its contents cannot be recovered. Give me both pieces of text.

In the RecipeNook app, the 'Saved Recipes' panel currently shows nothing when a user has not bookmarked any recipes yet. I need the empty-state text for that panel: a short heading, plus one or two sentences encouraging the user to browse recipes and tap the bookmark icon to save their first one. Write the full text.

The command-line tool 'deploybot' reads a file called deploy.yaml on startup. When that file is missing the required 'target' key, the tool should stop and print an error message to the terminal explaining that the config is invalid, naming the missing key, and telling the user which file to fix. Write that exact error message.

On the signup form for the app 'Wisplist', the 'Email' field must contain a valid email address and must not already be registered. Write the validation error text shown under the field for two cases: when the value 'notanemail' is entered with no @ sign, and when the address is already registered to another account.

Across the 'billing-service' repository, rename the function 'calcInvoiceTotal' to 'computeInvoiceTotal' everywhere it appears, including its definition and every call site, in the files invoice.ts, invoiceUtils.ts, and invoiceTests.ts. Do not change any other logic or comments. Reply only with the list of files you changed, nothing else.

In the file 'src/config/limits.ts' of the 'ParcelTrack' project, change the constant 'MAX_RETRY_COUNT' from its current value of 3 to a new value of 5, so the shipment sync job retries more times before giving up. Don't touch any other constants or add comments. Reply with only the single word 'done' when finished.
